Private Relay on the device vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

US/EU indie teams conflate iCloud+ system privacy features with storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate them:

  • iCloud Private Relay on the device — iCloud+ subscribers can route Safari traffic through Apple's relay so websites see less of the user's IP and DNS queries stay encrypted. Toggle under Settings → Apple Account → iCloud → Private Relay; related Safari privacy controls under Settings → Safari → Privacy. System iCloud+ behavior — outside AppLocale scope.

Connect text fields — this page.

  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of how strongly your US listing markets Private Relay.

Private Relay-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Browsing-privacy marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe iCloud Private Relay in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US VPN marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 专用代理 for Private Relay under Settings → Apple Account → iCloud, with related buyer language around iCloud 专用代理 (iCloud Private Relay), 隐藏 IP 地址 (hide IP address), 隐藏真实 IP (hide real IP), 浏览隐私 (browsing privacy), and Safari 隐私 (Safari privacy under Settings → Safari → Privacy). Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not third-party VPN superlatives like 翻墙 or standalone 代理服务器 product claims when your app only references Apple's system feature.

Private Relay vs Limit IP Address Tracking

Limit IP Address Tracking lives under Settings → Safari → Privacy — 隐藏 IP 跟踪 — and reduces cross-site IP tracking for Safari. iCloud Private Relay routes Safari traffic through Apple's iCloud+ relay — 专用代理. If your English gallery shows the Limit IP Address Tracking toggle, keep zh-Hans copy on tracking-limit vocabulary, not full relay claims, unless Private Relay is what the frame depicts.

Private Relay vs Hide My Email

Hide My Email generates relay email addresses for sign-in and Mail — not Safari IP masking. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 隐藏邮件地址 or Sign in with Apple relay copy when your English source only showed Private Relay under iCloud settings. See the Sign in with Apple guide only if Hide My Email is your lead marketing claim.

Private Relay vs VPN and proxy app positioning

Third-party VPN apps market tunnel products with server lists and subscription tiers — different Connect positioning from compatibility with Apple's iCloud+ relay. AppLocale rewrites listing metadata for apps that reference system Private Relay; we do not write VPN product pages, proxy server marketing, or claims that your binary ships relay infrastructure.

Private Relay vs Low Data Mode and Lockdown Mode

Low Data Mode throttles network usage for metered plans — 低数据模式. Lockdown Mode hardens device security for extreme threat models. Private Relay hides IP and encrypts DNS for Safari browsing — 专用代理. Do not keyword-stuff 低数据模式 or 锁定模式 when English only marketed hide-IP Safari privacy.

Terms like 专用代理, 隐藏 IP 地址, and Safari 隐私 each signal different intent from generic productivity keywords or unrelated iCloud file-sync terms.
